packages.name: callout-arrow
packages.title: Callout arrow
packages.description: A label on a pill with an arrow that draws out from it to a point of the picture, then a ring that pings around the point. Point at a detail the voice talks about: a button, a part, a face in a crowd.

packages.name: caption
packages.title: Karaoke caption
packages.description: Word-timed captions from a words JSON: the voice-over's words grouped into short lines, each line shown while it is spoken, the current word lit in the highlight color. Pass words as "$words:<spine-id>" so they follow the VO through every trim, or inline as [{w, s, e}] in seconds on the overlay's clock.

packages.name: clean
packages.title: Clean
packages.description: A neutral dark kit: off-white type on near-black, one warm yellow accent, Baloo 2 throughout, and house rules for pacing (one pop at a time, room between pops, a budget for punch-ins) and placement (graphics inside the action-safe area, names never over captions).

packages.name: counter
packages.title: Counter
packages.description: A number that counts from one value to another with an ease-out, then gives a small bump when it lands: a stat, a price, a score, a percentage. The number is an expression, so prefix, suffix, decimals and thousands separators are props. An optional label sits under it.

packages.name: freeze-frame-highlight
packages.title: Freeze frame highlight
packages.description: Footage that freezes on a moment with a camera-flash blink, dims everything but a circle around the point that matters, rings it, and names it. For "see this?" moments: a mistake, a tell, the thing to watch. Use it as a shot's picture.

packages.name: lower-third
packages.title: Lower third
packages.description: A name and a role on a plate in the lower left: the accent bar drops in, the plate wipes out from it, the words slide in, and everything fades on the element's end. For introducing a person, a place or a source.

packages.name: pip-frame
packages.title: Picture in picture
packages.description: A second video in a framed, shadowed box over the picture: a face cam, a reference clip, a before/after. It pops in, plays, and fades out on the element's end. Optional small label above the frame.

packages.name: pop-text
packages.title: Pop text
packages.description: A word or two that lands over the picture to stress what the voice says: pops (or rises) in, settles, and fades out on the element's end. Big, bold, outlined, readable over any footage. One at a time.

packages.name: progress-bar
packages.title: Progress bar
packages.description: A thin bar that fills over the element's length, from one fraction to another: how far into a chapter, a list or a countdown the viewer is. A dot rides the leading edge; an optional label sits above the start.

packages.name: title-card
packages.title: Title card
packages.description: A full-frame title for an opening or a new chapter: a big title that settles in, an accent rule that draws out from under it, and an optional subtitle that rises in after. A soft glow in the accent color sits behind the title. Use it as a shot's picture.

packages.name: zoom-punch
packages.title: Zoom punch
packages.description: Footage that punches in on a point at a moment: a fast keyframed scale toward the focus, then a hold (or an ease back out). The classic emphasis cut for a reaction, a detail or a punchline. Use it as a shot's picture; it fills the frame.
